incidents.observation: Initial official CLI smoke client waited in startup while REST status and kernels returned200 and the kernel was idle.
incidents.action: Closed only the stalled local smoke client, not the VM or scientific worker. A fresh console connection completed the T4 smoke successfully.

incidents.action: Transferred four pre-existing32MiB-or-smaller parts, assembled the original ZIP on the VM and verified its complete SHA256. No scientific bytes changed.

evaluation_backup_policy: Atomic JSON writes and acknowledged worker barriers before immutable ZIP creation; SHA256-verified external retrieval. A separate post-evaluation guard keeps the runtime active until the final PC copy is verified.
